title: 第23章 斩玄冥二老收张无忌第24章 入地榜天剑江寒
lines: 就在二人携手下山之际，广场上陡生变故。
两个不知道从哪里冒出来的老头，径直对张无忌出手。
待在张无忌身边的寇仲和小鱼儿，是唯二会武功的。
可是只一掌，寇仲和小鱼儿就被轰飞，徐子陵和韦小宝两人不会武功，连带着被劲道撞飞出去。
玄冥二老直接抓住张无忌，威胁张翠山夫妇。
“你们是要儿子，还是继续保守谢逊的秘密！”
玄冥二老深知整个武当山都是来恭贺祝寿的，老神仙张三丰也要从后山下来。
再待下去必定多生事端。
只是二人刚要带着张无忌逃跑，刚到广场的四大名捕外加护龙山庄三位密探齐齐出手。
如谪仙降临的张三丰从云端飘荡而下，旋即就看到了战作一团的众人。
或许是知道再纠缠下去讨不到好处，玄冥二老也深知在张三丰手上肯定带不走张无忌，于是心下一狠，两记玄冥神掌落在张无忌身上，阴冷的寒毒立刻入侵张无忌五脏六腑。
随手一丢，两人分散而逃。
作为武林上罕见的二人组，玄冥二老独特的合击之术，二人一起行动，有能叫板超绝的实力。
各自的实力，也都有宗师水平。
张三丰和一众人等关心张无忌的情况，四大名捕和护龙山庄三位密探追击玄冥二老。
江寒也在此列。
出手对付玄冥二老，全因为这两人居然对他的徒弟出手，江寒自然不可能让他们离开这里。
只是以玄冥二老的老道和实力，三大名捕和三位密探只能无功而返。
最后变成了江寒和追命两人追击。
原版的玄冥二老，实力在江湖上只能算是一流。
但两人结合，加上玄冥神掌这种阴损功夫罕见，所以即便是张三丰，也很棘手。
现在综武世界，玄冥二老的实力得到加强，变成联手只弱超绝一线的存在。
但两人蒙元走狗的身份却没变。
玄冥二老先前藏于武当山，见识了萧秋水和燕狂徒的绝技，也看到了江寒的万剑归宗。
现在身后的两个尾巴，一个是江寒，另外一个是四大名捕里的追命。
玄冥二老忌惮江寒的万剑归宗，自然不敢停留。
直到荒山野岭，玄冥二老察觉甩不脱二人，合计之下决定反杀两人。
现在山林野外，没有剑器供江寒使用万剑归宗的绝技，那他的实力必定大打折扣。
至于追命，一身功力全在腿上，实力不过顶尖。
对上他们两位宗师，要么跑，要么死！
“你们还真是锲而不舍。现在我们不跑了，就在这里，你们待如何？”玄冥二老面带杀机。
此番奉命前来，本就是蒙元派给的任务，看能不能捣乱，或者绑架，威胁得到屠龙宝刀的消息。
可没想到三位超绝给的压力太大，现在能从武当山全身而退，已实属难得。
江寒看着头发花白的玄冥二老，冷声道：“你们伤我弟子，就想这么一走了之，未免太不把我放在眼里了吧。”
此言一出，玄冥二老冷笑。
当真以为燕狂徒称赞两句，就狂到没边儿了？
剑道称雄，那也是未来，不是现在！
一个宗师，外加一个顶尖，还想硬扛两个宗师的联手进攻，属实可笑！
玄冥二老不再多言，联手出招。
森森寒气从两对手掌中轰出，周围山林都蒙上了一层冰霜。
追命本想上去帮忙，只是这刺骨的寒气让他寸步难行。
刚想进去，就觉得浑身血液、包括内力，都有种凝滞感觉。
反观江寒，和玄冥二老斗得不相上下。
content_en:
Just as the two of them were going down the mountain hand in hand, something unexpected happened in the square.
Two old men appeared out of nowhere and attacked Zhang Wuji.
Kou Zhong and Xiao Yu'er, who stayed beside Zhang Wuji, were the only two who knew martial arts.
But with just one palm, Kou Zhong and Xiao Yu'er were blown away. Xu Ziling and Wei Xiaobao, who didn't know martial arts, were knocked away by the force.
The two elders Xuan Ming directly grabbed Zhang Wuji and threatened Zhang Cuishan and his wife.
"Do you want a son, or continue to keep Xie Xun's secret!"
The two elders Xuan Ming knew that the entire Wudang Mountain was here to congratulate him on his birthday, and the old god Zhang Sanfeng was also coming down from the back mountain.
There will be more trouble if you stay any longer.
Just when the two of them were about to escape with Zhang Wuji, the four famous arrests who had just arrived at the square and the three spies from Hulong Villa all took action.
Zhang Sanfeng, who was like a banished immortal, floated down from the clouds and immediately saw the people fighting in a group.
Perhaps knowing that there would be no benefit in continuing to entangle, the two elders Xuan Ming also knew that Zhang Sanfeng would definitely not be able to take away Zhang Wuji, so they felt cruel and struck two Xuan Ming divine palms on Zhang Wuji, and the cold poison immediately invaded Zhang Wuji's internal organs.
Throwing it away, the two scattered and ran away.
As a rare duo in the martial arts world, Xuan Ming and Xuan Ming have a unique combined attack technique. When they act together, they have the ability to challenge others.
Their respective strengths are also at the level of a master.
Zhang Sanfeng and others were concerned about Zhang Wuji's situation, and the four famous arresters and the three secret agents of Hulong Villa pursued the two elders Xuan Ming.
Jiang Han is also on this list.
Taking action against the two elders Xuan Ming was all because these two people actually took action against his disciples. It was naturally impossible for Jiang Han to let them leave here.
However, with the sophistication and strength of the two elders Xuan Ming, the three famous arrests and the three spies could only return without success.
In the end, Jiang Han and Zhui Ming gave chase.
The original two elders, Xuanming and Ming, were only top-notch in strength in the arena.
But the combination of the two, and the rare destructive skills of the Xuanming Divine Palm, made it very difficult even for Zhang Sanfeng.
Now in the world of comprehensive martial arts, the strength of the two elders Xuan Ming has been strengthened, and they have become a weak and powerful existence together.
But the identity of the two Meng Yuan lackeys has not changed.
The two elders Xuan Ming had previously hid in Wudang Mountain and witnessed the unique skills of Xiao Qiushui and Yan Kuangtu, as well as Jiang Han's Ten Thousand Swords Guizong.
The two tails behind him now, one is Jiang Han, and the other is Zhui Ming, one of the four famous catchers.
The two elders Xuan Ming were afraid of Jiang Han's Wan Jian returning to the clan, so naturally they did not dare to stay.
Until they reached the barren mountains and wild ridges, the two elders Xuan Ming realized that they couldn't get away from them, so they decided to kill them together.
Now in the mountains and wilds, there are no swords for Jiang Han to use the unique skill of Ten Thousand Swords Returning to the Clan, so his strength must be greatly reduced.
As for chasing life, all the skills are in the legs, and the strength is not top-notch.
Facing these two masters, either run or die!
"You are really persevering. Now that we are not running away, we are here. How will you stay?" Xuan Ming and the other two elders looked murderous.
Being ordered to come here this time was originally a mission assigned by Meng Yuan, to see if he could cause trouble, or kidnap, and threaten to get the news of the dragon-slaying sword.
But I didn't expect that the pressure from the three super masters was too great. Now it is really rare to escape from Wudang Mountain.
Jiang Han looked at the gray-haired Xuan Ming elders and said coldly: "You hurt my disciple and just want to walk away like this. You are not taking me seriously."
As soon as these words came out, the two elders Xuan Ming sneered.
Do you really think that just a few words of praise from Kuangzu Yan will make him so crazy?
Swordsmanship is the future, not now!
It is ridiculous for a grandmaster and a top master to withstand the joint attack of two grandmasters!
The two elders Xuan Ming stopped talking and joined forces to attack.
The cold air blasted out from the two pairs of palms, and the surrounding mountains and forests were covered with a layer of frost.
Zhui Ming wanted to go up and help, but the biting cold air made it difficult for him to move.
Just as I was about to go in, I felt that all the blood in my body, including my internal energy, felt stagnant.
On the other hand, Jiang Han was evenly matched with the two elders Xuan Ming.
title_en: Chapter 23: Killing Xuanming and Zhang Wuji Chapter 24: Entering the Earth Ranking and Heavenly Sword Jiang Han
